page_title: VEN 0-1 ROM | Venezia v AS Roma 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Artem Dovbyk.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
89' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
86' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) commits a foul and Luca Zufferli immediately signals a free kick.
83' The ratio of the ball possession is 61:39.
81' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
80' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Daniel Fila and he is replaced by Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
80' Substitution. Kike Perez (Venezia) makes his way off the pitch and Mirko Maric comes on as his replacement.
77' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
75' None of the AS Roma players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
74' A pass lands at the feet of Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
73' The attendance is 9106.
71' Here is a change. Mikael Egill Ellertsson is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Zeki Celik (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Paulo Dybala.
67' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

66' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

65' Daniel Fila (Venezia) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mile Svilar pulls off an easy save.
64' Daniel Fila (Venezia) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
63' Mile Svilar leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alessio Zerbin (Venezia).
61' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Luca Zufferli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
58' Stephan El Shaarawy comes off the pitch to be replaced by Victor Nelsson (AS Roma).
58' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Lucas Gourna-Douath will be replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
58' Alessandro Marcandalli will be replaced by Joel Schingtienne (Venezia).
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) for John Yeboah.
57' 0 - 1 Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) leaves the keeper helpless with his precise penalty shot inside the right post.
57' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

56' Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) brings his opponent down. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for AS Roma.
54' Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' Corner kick. Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is ready to send the ball into the box.

51' He should have scored! Daniel Fila (Venezia) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out for a corner. Venezia can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Half-time substitution. Claudio Ranieri decided to make a change. Devyne Rensch is replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) is first to the cross from Kike Perez, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
42' Luca Zufferli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Angelino (AS Roma) and blew his whistle.

40' Angelino (AS Roma) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
40' There's an opportunity for Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
40' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
39' Good clearance! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
38' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle as Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
37' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
37' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. AS Roma get a corner.
33' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
30' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) meets a cross from the resulting free kick and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders makes a vital goal-line clearance.
29' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
24' Fali Cande (Venezia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
21' John Yeboah (Venezia) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mile Svilar makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
21' Venezia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Venezia force their opponents to concede a corner.
18' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Ionut Radu comes off his line to intercept.
17' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Ionut Radu is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
14' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

13' Play continues despite the shouts by some Venezia players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Luca Zufferli interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
13' Surely that's handball by one of the AS Roma players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
10' Daniel Fila (Venezia) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
9' Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.

7' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Ionut Radu pulls off a brilliant save.

5' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) just outside the box, who takes a shot. The strike heads low towards the right post, but it's deflected away thanks to a wonderful intervention by one of the defenders.
5' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
5' Angelino (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
4' Ionut Radu (Venezia) sends a long cross over to Mikael Egill Ellertsson, but Mile Svilar comes forward to gather the ball.
2' John Yeboah (Venezia) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Venezia will take the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
